The '''Svolten system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

It was located along the [[Descri Wris]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA" />
